name: tacet
typing: Sits in your meetings, speaks only when called
Seven gates in code decide if it may talk; the LLM does not vote
Files the minutes while the meeting is still running
tagline: An agent that sits in your meetings, listens to everything, speaks only when called, and files the minutes.
pitch: **tacet** is the meeting bot that knows when to shut up: mute by construction, it answers only inside a short window after its name, and writes decisions, action items and open questions down as they happen.

what.product: self-hosted meeting agent, silent unless called
what.joins: as a participant, through a transport you control
what.speaks: only after its wake word, inside a short follow-up window
what.gates: seven independent gates in src/core/floor.ts; the model decides what, not whether
what.notes: decisions, action items, open questions extracted live, crash-safe
